title: Cinema Sunday: Night at the Museum
seo_title: Cinema Sunday: Night at the Museum in Springfield, MO
description: Cinema Sunday is a screening of Night at the Museum, in which night guard Larry Daley discovers that the Natural History Museum's animals come to life after closing. Admission is free, but reservations are required; tickets can be reserved by phone at 417-863-9491 or in person, and reserved tickets must be redeemed at least 15 minutes before showtime. It takes place Sunday, February 21, 2027 at 2:00 PM at the Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central E., Springfield, MO, with general admission seating.
